items.title: Bitcoin Price Trades Above $81,500 as Fed Keeps Rates Steady in Split Vote
items.summary: Bitcoin price held near $81,000 after the Federal Reserve kept rates at 3.75% to 4% in a 10-2 vote. This post Bitcoin Price Trades Above $81,500 as Fed Keeps Rates Steady in Split Vote first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

items.title: Fed Stands Pat, Bitcoin Holds Steady–But a December Rate Hike Is in Play
items.summary: The Federal Reserve left rates unchanged Wednesday in a 10-2 vote, with Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack favoring a hike.

items.title: Strategy Shareholders Approve Daily Dividends on Preferred Stock, With 99.3% in Favor
items.summary: STRC will begin paying dividends for every calendar day from November, with STRF, STRK and STRD following in January.

items.summary: TLDR Bitcoin climbed to $81,687 on Wednesday, with bid liquidity thickening around $79,000 and $80,000. South Korea's KOSPI jumped 6.63% as tech stocks rebounded from earlier October losses. Morgan Stanley's Mike Wilson says most of the market correction is already over. items.title: Bitcoin price bounce rejected at 50-day trend line ahead of FOMC, earnings
items.summary: Bitcoin failed to move past its 50-day simple moving average as market participants awaited the outcome of the FOMC meeting and key tech earnings.

items.title: Wall Street's Fast Money Fled Bitcoin ETFs, Sovereign Funds Stepped In
items.summary: Galaxy Research found that nine hedge funds and banks cut 68,000 BTC worth of spot ETF exposure as the cash-and-carry trade dried up, while wealth platforms and sovereign funds added.

items.title: Bitwise raises bitcoin price target to $1.6 million by 2036, projects 34% annualized returns
items.summary: Bitwise's bear case puts bitcoin at $130,686 by 2036, while its bull case reaches $3.67 million over the next decade.
